# Keep expired draft recovery closed for keyboard users

## What & Why
The exact-deadline protection is covered for pointer clicks, but keyboard activation is another way users can trigger the same recovery action. A regression could reopen an expired draft for keyboard users while pointer users remain protected.

## Done looks like
- Pressing Enter or Space on an answer draft recovery control at its exact deadline does not open the edit form.
- The same boundary is covered for opportunity drafts.
- The existing no-longer-available announcements remain intact.
